id.description: Hugging Face repo id, intended for DiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained

variant.description: Checkpoint/variant label when the repo id alone doesn't disambiguate it

org.description: Organization or lab that produced the model

params.description: Parameter count, e.g. '5B', or a MoE breakdown like '27B total / 14B active per step'

license.description: License identifier, e.g. Apache-2.0. Only unconditionally free licenses belong in this catalog.

min_vram_gb.description: Minimum VRAM in GB at standard precision; null if not confirmed

min_vram_gb_quantized.description: Minimum VRAM in GB when quantized (only set if meaningfully different from min_vram_gb)

min_vram_gb_optimized.description: Minimum VRAM in GB with optimized/offloaded inference (only set if meaningfully different from min_vram_gb)

preferred_for.description: video_type ids (see rules.json) this model has a genuine style/quality edge for, e.g. from its notes — a soft tie-breaker among capability+VRAM matches, not a hard requirement

notes.description: Caveats, benchmarks, or licensing nuance worth flagging
